# dual_screen_hinge

Cross-platform Flutter plugin for continuous foldable hinge angles, posture,
feature geometry, active screen role, and Android display modes.

Canonical API:
- DualScreenHinge.instance.events
- DualScreenHinge.instance.hingeAngleEvents
- currentState(), capabilities()
- startRearDisplay(), stopRearDisplay()
- startDualScreen(entrypoint, arguments), stopDualScreen()

Use MediaQuery.displayFeatures for adaptive Android layout. Use this plugin for
raw angles, richer metadata, display sessions, and iOS. Unknown native enum
values map to unknown. Android screen identity is nullable/unknown unless a
Window Area session proves it. No model allowlists or private APIs.

Source: https://github.com/Code-Growers/dual_screen_hinge
Docs: https://code-growers.github.io/dual_screen_hinge/
